[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the perfect Spaghetti Carbonara, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Use high-quality ingredients: Fresh eggs, guanciale or pancetta, and Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cook spaghetti al dente.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Don't overcook the guanciale.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use room temperature eggs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Whisk eggs just until lightly beaten.
